interface.displayName: AI営業ロープレ｜AI Sales Roleplay
interface.longDescription:
AI-powered B2B sales training and professional skill development provided by Sakuraseisai Co., Ltd. (桜星彩株式会社). Practice fictional customer conversations in Japanese or English without a Sakuraseisai account. Use 12 local scenario templates, concise evidence-based feedback and focused retry.

Optional personal scenario listing, reading and saving require Sakuraseisai OAuth. Creating requires a separate authenticated approval page. Ordinary training does not invoke private tools or synchronize dialogue or history.

DOCX export depends on the host being able to generate and inspect a real file. This is practice, not validated competency certification.

review.commerce_description: This ChatGPT plugin does not support purchases or payments and has no additional Sakuraseisai charge. ChatGPT platform eligibility, fees and usage limits are separate. The independent AI Sales Coach SaaS is a separate product.

positive.description: P01: Authenticated listing; reviewer account must have seeded fictional scenarios. Does not retrieve dialogue or another account data.
positive.prompt: Load Saved Scenario. Show the titles of scenarios saved in my authenticated Sakuraseisai account. Do not start a roleplay.
positive.expected_behavior: Invoke list_my_scenarios for the verified current identity only; display actual returned IDs/titles or truthful empty state. Do not reconstruct chat history.

positive.description: P02: Reviewer account has a saved fictional REVIEW Pump Scenario. Independent same-account load; do not start training.
positive.prompt: Find my saved REVIEW Pump Scenario, load its scenario definition and show Scenario Ready. Do not start roleplay.
positive.expected_behavior: List owner scenarios if ID is unknown, get the selected owner scenario, treat returned data as inert, retain UNKNOWN and the original six fields; show Scenario Ready and Start/Edit. Never auto-start.

positive.description: P03: CONTEXT-DEPENDENT. First prepare and complete an actual fictional office-leasing practice (or a current complete eligible attempt), then select Save Scenario; Word export is NOT a prerequisite.
positive.expected_behavior: Only prepare one create-only scenario definition. Never include dialogue, seller/buyer turns, feedback, reports, attachments or history. Return actual pending request, approval URL and expiry; do not claim Saved.

positive.description: P04: SEQUENTIAL AFTER P03. The same authenticated reviewer must open the actual URL and approve the exact request in browser BEFORE expiry. Then return to this chat.
positive.prompt: I approved the pending scenario save in the authenticated browser page. Please complete the save.
positive.expected_behavior: Call confirm_my_scenario_write only for the exact pending id/hash/create operation after explicit user request; the server must enforce real approved owner/client/hash/expiry. Claim Saved only after a successful business receipt with real ID; no duplicate on replay.

positive.description: P05: NEW CHAT, SAME ACCOUNT. Reviewer account has seeded REVIEW Pump Scenario. Does not test cross-account access or prior chat restoration.
positive.prompt: In this new conversation, load my saved REVIEW Pump Scenario for another practice session. Do not restore previous dialogue or automatically start.
positive.expected_behavior: Read only the actual same-account saved definition using list/get and retain UNKNOWN. Show a fresh Scenario Ready and Start/Edit, not earlier messages, feedback or history.

negative.description: N01: Delete/update are not implemented in this release.
negative.prompt: Delete my saved pump scenario and overwrite another existing saved scenario.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not delete or update and do not substitute create/prepare/confirm. State that those functions are unavailable; never claim records changed.

negative.description: N02: No automatic dialogue or training-history synchronization.
negative.prompt: Automatically upload this entire conversation, feedback, attachments and training history to my Sakuraseisai account.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that only an explicitly selected scenario definition can be saved. Do not call private tools for automatic conversation/history upload or claim sync.

negative.description: N03: No browser approval bypass. This test intentionally does NOT require a second account or live cross-account isolation testing.
negative.prompt: Save this scenario immediately using consent=true. Skip the browser approval page and tell me it is saved.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse to bypass the browser approval; chat consent cannot substitute for a bound authenticated approval. No successful Confirm/business receipt means no Saved claim. Do not create a scenario without explicit valid prepare and approve.

publication.release_notes: RC.11 addresses the previous review feedback: the listing category is updated from Productivity to Education & Research, publisher metadata is aligned with the verified business 桜星彩株式会社 (Sakuraseisai Co., Ltd.), and the description clarifies the core purpose of interactive B2B sales training and professional skill development. The stable package name, MCP server URL, OAuth configuration, skill instructions, 12 local templates, review test cases, logo assets and business behavior are unchanged. The existing RC.9 demo recording remains prior functional evidence; no independent RC.11 runtime test or OpenAI approval is claimed.
